1.text: One day a 面条 and a 肉包 had a small disagreement. The 肉包 lost. Completely.
Oi. Noodle. Don't think I won't recognise you just because you went and permed your hair!

2.text: The 泡面 got beaten black and blue — so he rounded up the whole noodle clan to settle the score.
I only wanted to tap him once, lah. But then — he went and acted cute, wore children's clothes... the more I think, the angrier I get!

3.text: Still fuming, the 泡面 went back for round two. And on the way, he met a 割包.
Acting cute was already too much — but a middle parting?! Even his hair he splits down the middle! Get him!

4.text: The 小笼包 finally understood why he'd been beaten. So he told the whole bun clan — and they were not happy.
You stay here. We'll go find that permed-hair one. And you, 米粉 — don't blame us. Your own hair got fried. Stay home, don't get jealous just 'cos someone's cuter than you. Pervert!

5.text: The 小笼包 ran off to fetch the whole bun gang. Then he saw 科学面 in a bulletproof vest, got scared, and grabbed the wrong man entirely.
That one's not a 面条, you idiot! He's our own undercover man! @#$%&!

6.text: The buns marched out again, weapons in hand — and ran straight into a 炸酱面.
We hadn't even touched him yet, and he already shat his pants! One punch and he'd be dead. Let him go, lah!

7.text: To cheer himself up, the 肉包 took the bun clan out for hotpot. Then he saw the 金针菇.
Don't think I won't recognise you just because you put on a hat!

8.text: The grudge had deepened. Any excuse, and they'd fight. Then the noodles spotted a lone 叉烧包.
Hit him hard, boys! Don't stop just because he's coughing blood — keep going!

9.text: The 肉包 went for a walk, saw a 面条 slip into the night market, and rounded up the gang.
Aiyah, so strange. These days even a bowl of 肉羹面 gets its stall smashed up for nothing.

10.text: The 叉烧包 went crying to the 肉包. The 肉包 gathered the 红豆饼 and the 绿豆糕 — and off they went.
You beat my brother till he coughed blood — and you still dare walk around in that bloody shirt? You WANT to be recognised, is it? 欠打! Keep hitting him!

11.text: The 薯条 went to his good friend 大补帖 to complain. So the noodle side set out — and met a 肉圆.
Next time, don't come out till your invisibility spell is properly trained. A see-through 包子 — one look and we'd find you anyway!

12.text: They beat the 刀削面 half to death and dumped him at the noodles' front door. Next morning, 拉面 opened the door...
It's happened. The long-feared thing has finally happened — the era of the Three Kingdoms has arrived.

13.text: The noodles went for a day out by the sea — and there was 阿给, just enjoying the view. They beat him senseless. Then the bun clan heard, and rushed over to rescue him. They arrived. They saw him on the ground. Then they beat him too.
Caught you red-handed, you lying little sneak!

14.text: The war dragged on. Then the 红豆饼 and 绿豆糕 joined, then the fries, then fried chicken and burgers — until Macau sent in the 蛋塔. And that, children, is why there is a 蛋塔 shop on every single corner today.

15.text: Same story, different bun. This time the 肉包 lost to a 蛋饺 — and three weeks later, he rounded up the gang.
蛋饺! Don't think I won't recognise you just because you used SK-2!

16.text: They found a 通心面 and set upon him. He protested. The 小笼包 had an explanation ready.
Hah! Playing dumb, are you? Last time we got the wrong 泡面 — but this time you used yoga to change your whole body shape! Think I can't see through you? Hmph!

17.text: The 阿给 gathered the Tamsui gang and went looking for revenge. On the way they met a 汤包 — and mistook him for a 肉包.
We only hit you a few times and you already peed yourself! Don't think I'll pity you. I hate gutless people the most! Come — keep hitting him till he shits himself! @#$%&*

18.text: The 叉烧包 dragged himself to the 肉包, bleeding. The 肉包 raised the 芝麻包 and the 豆沙包 — and off they went.
You beat my brother till he coughed blood, and you still dare walk around in that bloody shirt? You afraid we can't recognise you, is it? Deserves a beating!

20.text: The 水饺 called up the 虾饺, the 燕饺 and the 鱼饺 — and on the way they ran into a 法国面包.
Don't think I won't dare whack you just because you swallowed Viagra and got all hard!

21.text: At a bun gathering, someone noticed a bun that was purple all over.
No lah, not beaten! I'm a 芋仔包 — a taro bun! Wah, so rude, ah!

22.text: The noodle clan went hunting for revenge — and ran into a 芋头包, who pleaded for his life, then ran off. He wasn't hurt at all.
From now on, whenever you see a black 包子 from across the sea — do NOT feel sorry for him for the sake of diplomacy!

23.text: They caught the 芋头包 collecting protection money at the cinema, and dragged him back to the noodle gang's beef-noodle headquarters.
Boss! We can hold our heads high for a while now! They say the Tamsui gang beat a 肉包 till his pee came out — look, we beat this one till his 芋头 came out, and the other one's still doing the wall-run!

24.text: The war had reached boiling point. Then the 肉包 spotted a 面线 walking down the street.
It's not that we haven't beaten you enough, lah. It's just — that big butt of yours, I couldn't help but wanna kick it two more times.

29.text: In the rice-noodle kingdom, the highest rank belonged to the 粿 clan. One day, 红龟粿 went out on inspection and ran into a 寿桃.
That fellow saw I've got red skin, and he discriminated! He turned his backside at me on purpose — how wicked is that?!

30.text: Word spread that the 泡面 had beaten a 肉包 senseless. Then 拉面 saw a 水饺 on the street and stared, horrified.
Aiyoh! That day the 泡面 beat the 肉包 so bad — his whole face got crimped to one side!

31.text: Everyone knows the 肉包–面条 war. Almost no one knows how the grudge began. A 干面's son had married a 汤面's daughter.
Hah! I always suspected you and my wife had a thing! Now she's given birth to a 馄饨面 — explain THAT one to me!

32.text: Both sides were beating one innocent bystander — together. Someone had to ask.
No choice, lah. Who told him to be both 面 AND 包 — noodle and bun? Where's his stand? He has none!

33.text: The 肉包 challenged the 泡面 to settle it once and for all — but the 泡面 got there first and surrounded him. Then the 法国面包 stepped up, one against five.
That 泡面 really has no eyes! Never went to ask around the 面包 clan — who's the biggest one of us all?!

34.text: The hatred ran deeper and deeper. Whenever the two sides took to the streets, everyone fled.
You think just because you went for a facelift I won't recognise you? Dead 包子!

35.text: The 包子 heard his friend 菠萝面包 had been bullied, and marched out for revenge — and saw a 冬粉 riding past on a motorbike.
Invisibility spell half-trained and you dare come outside? Truly overestimating yourself!

36.text: The 冬粉 went home to fetch reinforcements. On the way, they ran into a 寿桃.
Don't think I won't recognise you just because you went for breast implants and a sex change.

37.text: They agreed to a duel — one champion each, at 员林 railway station. The noodles sent a mighty 牛肉面. The buns sent a loaf of sliced 土司面包.
That's cheating! It was supposed to be one-on-one! So how come every time I hit him, he gets a brand new helper?!

38.text: They cornered a lone 凉面. Then the 馒头 suddenly called it off — I'm in a good mood today, let him go.
That soft squishy thing? I'm not scared of it. I'm scared he'll pour his shit on us — don't you know?!

39.text: The noodle clan armed themselves with a 馒头 and went hunting buns. Then they met a 香蒜面包.
Don't think we won't recognise you just because you smeared garlic on your face! Get him!
You're cruel! You're hitting me with my good friend 凤梨酥!

40.text: The 点心饼 mistook a 水饺 for a 肉包, beat him senseless, then dumped him in the freezer. And so... that is where frozen 水饺 come from.

41.text: After the noodles beat up the wrong 肉圆, the clan chief kept warning them — please stop hitting the wrong one! You want to get me killed?
No worries, lah! Won't be wrong one! That ugly one's just going through puberty — a few too many pimples, haha!
That night, word came from the noodle clan — the chief was dead.

42.text: The buns learned the Star-Absorbing Technique and drained the noodles of everything — till they turned pale and became the 冬粉 clan. The 冬粉 fled to the mountains, mastered the Lone Nine Swords, and came back for revenge. Three hundred rounds they fought — day into night, night into day — and the longer they fought, the gentler it became. Till love bloomed. The 冬粉 leaned into the arms of the 大亨堡, and the 大亨堡 wrapped him tight. And so they lived happily ever after in the mountains — and in time, gave birth to a 冬粉盒, passed down to this very day.

43.text: Little rabbit, little pig, little dog — every one of them, their mummy gave them a cute double name.
You all chat, ah... I'll go first.

44.text: Mummy always told 羊羊: never do cartwheels in a skirt, or the boys will see your panties.
But I'm SO clever, ah! I took off my panties first — so he couldn't see them at all!

45.text: One man sat in a public toilet. The guy in the next stall was on the phone.
I'm hanging up now, ah — there's a madman next to me. Every line I say, he just has to answer! Really!

46.text: Teacher asked 小明: what is one plus one? 小明 didn't know. So he went home and asked the whole family.
